marketNotes.text: All prices are brutto (23% VAT). Senetic, Bechtle, Proshop and 4hfix also show netto; brutto recorded.
Bechtle sells only to businesses and public buyers.
Ceneo listed 13 offers for HPE Q2079A on 2026-10-23, from 420.00 zł (empik.com) to 669.17 zł.
Morele.net is a marketplace; NET-S and other marketplace offers are recorded under their own names. On 2026-10-23 several Morele items moved between NET-S and Morele.net as the selling party.
No Polish seller showed a priced LTO-10 drive or 40 TB LTO-10 cartridge on 2026-10-23; HPE P84145-B25 and P84147-B25 on Morele are tape autoloader/library units, not drives.
On 2026-10-23 4hfix listed only its Quantum LTO-9 tape, now 690 zł (390 zł in September); its LTO-7 and LTO-8 pages redirect to the category.
Senetic raised HPE BC022A (LTO-8 internal) to 49,370.44 zł brutto on 2026-10-23, about double September's 24,919.37 zł; it remains out of stock.
Komputronik and Proshop pages load in a browser but refuse plain HTTP fetches; both were read on 2026-10-23.
MC Storage (Fujifilm distributor) lists LTO-10 media without public prices.
Stovaris B2B (MagStor distributor) shows prices only after login.
Gigaserwer prices come from search listings; product pages did not render and stock is not shown. Searches return empty without a session cookie.
Bechtle marks Overland-Tandberg LTO-9 HH drives (TD-LTO9ISA) and Quantum LTO-6 tape (MR-L6MQN-01) as no longer available.
Dell 440-BBJU single LTO-9 kits cost 1,521.09 to 1,785.49 zł, about four times a generic LTO-9 cartridge.
